as_told.title: Caltech Planet 9/10 inferred from Kuiper belt perturbations

plain: An astronomer at Caltech said there is a 99 percent chance that a large unseen ninth planet, called Planet Nine, exists in the far outer solar system. A researcher named Matt LaCroix tells Michels this without naming the astronomer. He gives the evidence as the orbits of Kuiper belt objects, the icy bodies beyond Neptune, which are "super skewed" and "perturbed by something" big.
